name: Open XDMoD
summary: NSF-funded open-source metrics/accounting framework for national HPC/research-computing allocations (originally for XSEDE/ACCESS): tracks job-level resource utilization per allocation, project, and user so funders and operators can audit how a granted compute allocation was actually spent.

name: Trustee
summary: CNCF Confidential Containers project's attestation and secret-management components: implements the verifier side of TDX/SGX/SEV-SNP remote attestation and gates secret release on the resulting evidence.

name: CMC (Fraunhofer AISEC)
summary: Academic (Fraunhofer AISEC) toolkit for remote attestation of computing platforms and attested TLS/HTTPS channels between them, supporting TPM, AMD SEV-SNP, Intel SGX and other TEE technologies.

name: GCE TCB Verifier
summary: Google's tools for creating and verifying signed 'launch endorsements' (golden firmware measurements) for Google Compute Engine Confidential VM firmware (SEV-SNP), letting a verifier check a VM's measurement against the golden reference.
